resources.string: Show a draggable progress capsule during screen control, background tasks, or when your input is needed. Drag the text to move it; tap it to open Theta. Stop requests cancellation immediately; an already running tool may take time to exit.
Without overlay permission, task progress remains in notifications. Enable notifications in system settings to see it.
Overlay permission granted. Turning this switch off removes the capsule immediately.
